related.title: Universal Robots UR5 協作手臂
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付座標鏈、兩組統計量與校準前後比較。；教學驗收要求 |平均偏差|≤0.02 mm 且 σ≤0.04 mm；原方案兩項失敗，改善需各自證明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the frame chain, two statistics sets and before/after calibration comparison.; Teaching acceptance requires |mean bias| ≤0.02 mm and σ≤0.04 mm; the original fails both and each improvement needs evidence.
related.difference: 理解延遲距離和減速距離需相加，並識別簡化模型的適用界限。
related.differenceEn: Add delay distance to braking distance and identify the simplified model boundary.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 獨立零均值誤差可用平方和開根號；系統偏差需另列而不能隱藏在 RSS。；教學標準差為手臂 0.03 mm、視覺 0.04 mm；另有 0.12 mm 校準偏差。；σ=sqrt(0.03²+0.04²)=0.05 mm；偏差仍為 0.12 mm。
d=vT+v²/(2a)，第一項為延遲，第二項為等減速度停止距離。；教學滑塊 v=0.50 m/s、T=0.20 s、a=1.0 m/s²，完全離線計算。；d=0.5×0.2+0.5²/(2×1)=0.225 m。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Independent zero-mean errors combine by RSS; systematic bias must remain separate.; Teaching standard deviations: robot 0.03 mm and vision 0.04 mm; calibration bias is separately 0.12 mm.; σ=sqrt(0.03²+0.04²)=0.05 mm; the bias remains 0.12 mm.
d=vT+v²/(2a): delay travel plus constant-deceleration braking distance.; Offline teaching slider: v=0.50 m/s, T=0.20 s, a=1.0 m/s².; d=0.5×0.2+0.5²/(2×1)=0.225 m.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Intuitive da Vinci 手術平台概覽
related.titleEn: Intuitive da Vinci surgical platform overview
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付座標鏈、兩組統計量與校準前後比較。；教學驗收要求 |平均偏差|≤0.02 mm 且 σ≤0.04 mm；原方案兩項失敗，改善需各自證明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the frame chain, two statistics sets and before/after calibration comparison.; Teaching acceptance requires |mean bias| ≤0.02 mm and σ≤0.04 mm; the original fails both and each improvement needs evidence.
related.difference: 以桌上紙筆主從機構理解縮放與量測誤差，不進行臨床操作。
related.differenceEn: Understand scaling and measurement error using a paper master–slave mechanism, without clinical activity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 獨立零均值誤差可用平方和開根號；系統偏差需另列而不能隱藏在 RSS。；教學標準差為手臂 0.03 mm、視覺 0.04 mm；另有 0.12 mm 校準偏差。；σ=sqrt(0.03²+0.04²)=0.05 mm；偏差仍為 0.12 mm。
理想位移縮放 xs=xm/r，輸入位移誤差也除以 r，但末端機械誤差不會因此消失。；教學 xm=10 mm、比例 r=5、主控量測不確定量 0.20 mm。；xs=10/5=2 mm；輸入誤差映射為 0.20/5=0.04 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Independent zero-mean errors combine by RSS; systematic bias must remain separate.; Teaching standard deviations: robot 0.03 mm and vision 0.04 mm; calibration bias is separately 0.12 mm.; σ=sqrt(0.03²+0.04²)=0.05 mm; the bias remains 0.12 mm.

Ideal scaling is xs=xm/r; input error also divides by r, while downstream mechanical error remains.; Teaching xm=10 mm, r=5 and master measurement uncertainty 0.20 mm.; xs=10/5=2 mm; mapped input error is 0.20/5=0.04 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
